tools.name: price_verdict
tools.description: Use before buying or recommending a specific product at a known price in euros. Give brand and model (and the merchant page if you have it) with the price. Returns 'bon', 'moyen', 'mauvais' or 'inconnu', the price range buyers approved, the usual price they report, how many observations support it a

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Use when someone wants to buy something, precise or vague ('noise-cancelling headphones under 200 €', 'a gift for a DIY dad'). Returns at most five offers seen in the last three days in France or Germany, each with price, merchant link when known, separate relevance, deal-quality and purchase-feasib

tools.name: create_watch
tools.description: Use when the person wants to be told when a good deal appears, and has agreed to receive e-mail. Sends them a confirmation link; nothing is watched until they open it, and you cannot confirm for them.

tools.name: get_watch
tools.description: State of a watch created with create_watch: awaiting confirmation, active or stopped, and how many alerts were sent.

tools.name: stop_watch
tools.description: Stop a watch created with create_watch. Safe to repeat.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_deals" is 1246 chars, far longer than this server's median (200). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
